headquarters.brief: A wide landscape image (3:2) of the interior of a grand fantasy adventurers' guild hall, the headquarters of a guild. North wall across the top: warm timber and stone with tall arched windows, hanging guild banners and lanterns. Centre-north: a raised two-step wooden dais holding a large carved guildmaster's desk with a world map, candles and a quill, and open floor behind and in front of the desk; the desk has no chair. West wall middle: a wide open timber archway leading into a side room. East wall middle: a wide open stone archway leading into a dim corridor. Centre floor: polished wooden planks with a long woven runner rug from the south door to the dais, benches against the walls, potted plants, a notice board, a weapon rack and a trophy shelf against the walls. South edge centre: a wide wooden double door to the outside. A big stone fireplace on the north-west wall with its hearth empty and dark (a fire is added later). Keep the middle of the floor wide open.
headquarters.slots: the empty fireplace hearth, three unlit wall lanterns on the north wall, and two bare floor spots beside the fireplace

common-room.brief: A landscape image (3:2) of a cozy fantasy guild common room beside the main hall, where adventurers without a project sit and work: a reading nook and study. East wall middle: a wide open timber archway back to the main hall. Two long sturdy wooden study tables with books, candles and maps, and one round table, all standing free on the floor with no chairs or benches at them; bookshelves, a map cabinet, a cozy rug, a small window seat, potted plants and a tea cart against the walls; a small stone hearth on the north wall with its fire empty.
common-room.slots: the empty hearth, two unlit candle sconces, and one bare spot on the rug

gallery.brief: A very wide landscape image (2:1) of a long horizontal guild hall corridor. The north wall runs across the top with five identical, evenly spaced, empty arched stone niches, each niche exactly the same and framed by timber pillars, each niche empty (plain recessed stone, no door, no decoration inside) because doors are placed in them later; above each niche an empty iron rod where a banner hangs later. The west end (left edge) is an open stone archway back into a bright hall; the east end (right edge) is a closed timber wall with a small round window. Floor: polished wooden planks with a long red runner carpet along the corridor, a few benches and potted plants between niches against the wall. The middle three niche sections must look identical so they can be repeated side by side.
gallery.slots: the five empty niches and their empty banner rods, and a small unlit lantern on each pillar

wing-small.brief: A square image of a cozy fantasy guild workshop room: the wing of a guild hall where adventurers work on one project. North wall: timber and stone with a window and an empty iron rod centred high on the wall where a banner will hang (leave the rod empty). Three sturdy wooden workbench desks standing free with scrolls, tools, a candle and a small glowing crystal on each, with no stools, chairs or benches at them, spaced apart with wide open floor around them; shelves of supplies, a chalkboard and a rack of tools on the walls; a door at the south edge centre.
wing-small.slots: the empty banner rod and one bare corner spot

wing-large.brief: A wide landscape image (3:2) of a large cozy fantasy guild workshop hall: the wing of a guild hall where a team of adventurers works on one project. North wall: timber and stone with tall windows and an empty iron rod centred high on the wall where a banner will hang (leave the rod empty). Eight sturdy wooden workbench desks standing free in two rows of four, each with scrolls, tools, a candle and a small glowing crystal, with no stools, chairs or benches at them; a central work table with a large map; shelves, a supply rack, a chalkboard and a small stone hearth with its fire empty on the walls; a door at the south edge centre; wide open aisles between desks.
wing-large.slots: the empty banner rod, the empty hearth, and two bare floor spots near the walls

square.brief: A very wide landscape image (2:1) of a cozy storybook fantasy village square at dusk, seen from above at a 3/4 angle. Along the north edge, a row of six distinct building fronts facing south, each with one clear front door at ground level and room above it for a hanging sign: left to right, a grand timber-and-stone guild hall with a wide double door (the largest), a blacksmith's forge with an open anvil yard, a quest office with a notice board beside its door, a tall library with arched windows, a cozy inn with a balcony, and a round stone rookery tower with perches. The cobbled square in front is wide open, with a round stone fountain in the middle whose basin is dry and empty (water is added later), a few market stalls, benches, lamp posts, flower planters and trees at the edges, and lanes leaving to the east and west.
square.slots: the dry fountain basin, an empty sign bracket above each of the six doors, and unlit lamp posts

inn.brief: A landscape image (3:2) of a cozy fantasy village inn's common room at night, where tired adventurers rest and doze. A long bar counter with tankards, barrels and bottles on the north wall with open floor behind it for the innkeeper; four sturdy wooden tables standing free with no chairs or benches at them; a big stone fireplace on the west wall with its hearth empty; a staircase up to rooms on the east wall; warm rugs, hanging herbs, lanterns; a door at the south edge centre.
inn.slots: the empty hearth, open floor behind the bar for the innkeeper, and two bare spots by the fireplace

rookery.brief: A square image of the round interior of a fantasy rookery tower where messenger birds carry letters: curved stone walls lined with wooden perches and pigeonholes stuffed with rolled letters, a big sorting desk in the middle standing free with sealing wax, scales and parcels and no chair at it, an open arched window high on the north wall where birds fly in and out, a ladder to an upper loft, sacks of mail, warm lantern light; a door at the south edge centre.
rookery.slots: the empty perches, open floor beside the sorting desk for the rookery keeper, and the open window

forge.brief: A landscape image (3:2) of the interior of a fantasy blacksmith's forge and workshop where weapons are crafted: a big brick forge with its fire pit empty and dark on the north wall, a large anvil, a quench trough of water, four long sturdy workbenches standing free in two rows with tools but nothing being crafted on them (crafted pieces are placed later), with no stools at them, racks of hammers and tongs, a grindstone, a weapon display rack, open floor between benches; a wide door at the south edge centre.
forge.slots: the empty forge fire pit, the empty tops of the four workbenches, and open floor behind the anvil for the smith

quest-office.brief: A landscape image (3:2) of the interior of a fantasy adventurers' quest office: a huge cork-and-timber quest board covering most of the north wall with no notices pinned on it (notices are placed later), a clerk's counter on the east side with ledgers, stamps and an inkwell and open floor behind it, two reading tables standing free with no chairs at them, filing cabinets and map tubes, a world map, warm lantern light; a door at the south edge centre.
quest-office.slots: the empty quest board, open floor behind the counter for the clerk

library.brief: A landscape image (3:2) of the interior of a grand fantasy library: tall carved bookshelves full of books along the walls and in two free-standing rows, a rolling ladder, a central reading desk with a large open tome and candles, a librarian's desk on the north side with open floor behind it, a globe, a cozy reading corner, star charts, tall arched windows with moonlight; reading tables standing free with no chairs at them; a door at the south edge centre.
library.slots: open floor behind the librarian's desk, and two bare spots on the reading rug

harbour.brief: A very wide landscape image (2:1) of a cozy storybook fantasy harbour market lane at dusk, seen from above at a 3/4 angle: along the north, a row of small shop fronts (a fishmonger, a sail maker, a tavern with a lantern), a wooden quay along the south edge with moored boats and gulls' perches, stacked crates and barrels, market stalls, a small lighthouse at the east end, cobbles, lamp posts, flower boxes; the west edge is an open lane back to the village square.
harbour.slots: the west lane back to the square, unlit lamp posts, and bare spots on the quay and by the stalls

doors.brief: five items, each sized to fill an arched stone niche about 2 squares wide and 3 tall where a person is 1.5 squares tall: 1. a closed arched oak door with iron bands and warm light glowing under it; 2. the same door standing open, revealing a warm glowing workshop interior; 3. the same door closed up: boarded with crossed planks, a little dust and cobweb, unlit; 4. a hanging cloth banner on a short iron rod, plain cream cloth with a simple embroidered border and an empty middle (no emblem, no text); 5. the same banner in deep red cloth.

fire.brief: four animation frames of the same crackling hearth fire on burning logs, sized to fill a stone fireplace hearth about 2 squares wide, the flames shifting shape frame to frame for a seamless loop, warm orange and yellow with a few sparks.

water.brief: four animation frames of the same clear blue water surface filling a round stone fountain basin about 4 squares wide, seen from above at a 3/4 angle, with a small jet in the middle and ripples that move outward frame to frame for a seamless loop; water only, no stone rim.

bird.brief: four animation frames of the same small grey-and-white messenger pigeon flying to the right with a rolled letter tied to one leg, wings up, level, down, level, for a seamless flight loop, sized about half a square.

forge-items.brief: three items, the same longsword blade lying flat on a workbench, seen from above at a 3/4 angle, about 3 squares long: 1. the blade finished and gleaming steel with a faint cool blue shimmer and a wisp of steam (passing); 2. the same blade cracked with a dark red glowing crack and a little smoke (failing); 3. the same blade glowing bright orange-hot as if just pulled from the fire (running).

notices.brief: four items, each a single loose parchment notice with a brass pin at its top, front facing, drawn on its own with no cork board, frame or background behind it, about 1 square wide and 1.3 tall, each with scribbled illegible lines (no readable text): 1. a plain cream notice; 2. a notice with a red wax seal (urgent); 3. a notice with a green ribbon (done); 4. a notice with a round deep blue ink stamp, clearly blue and not green (in progress).

props.brief: six items: 1. a tall wooden bed with a patchwork quilt, seen in 3/4 view; 2. a small pile of rolled letters tied with string; 3. a brass handbell; 4. an open glowing tome; 5. a lit candle on a brass holder; 6. a sleepy orange tabby cat curled up.

fidget-pet.brief: four animation frames of the same fluffy orange tabby cat sitting on the floor, about 1 square tall: 1. sitting upright looking at the viewer; 2. eyes closed, purring, leaning into a pet; 3. stretching with its back arched; 4. licking a paw.

fidget-spin.brief: four animation frames of the same small brass desk globe on a wooden stand, about 1 square tall, the globe turned a quarter further in each frame so it spins in a seamless loop.

fidget-toggles.brief: six items, each about 1 square tall: 1. a brass hand bell on a small wooden stand, still; 2. the same bell tilted and ringing with small motion lines; 3. a three-branch iron candelabra with unlit candles; 4. the same candelabra with all three candles lit and glowing; 5. a closed wooden music box; 6. the same music box open with a tiny dancer and small music notes floating.

pet-cat-black.brief: four animation frames of the same a sleek black cat with green eyes on the floor, about 1 square tall: 1. sitting calmly looking at the viewer; 2. happy, leaning into a pet with eyes closed; 3. a playful pose; 4. curled up asleep.

pet-hound.brief: four animation frames of the same a scruffy brown hound dog with floppy ears on the floor, about 1 square tall: 1. sitting calmly looking at the viewer; 2. happy, leaning into a pet with eyes closed; 3. a playful pose; 4. curled up asleep.

pet-owl.brief: four animation frames of the same a small round barn owl on the floor, about 1 square tall: 1. sitting calmly looking at the viewer; 2. happy, leaning into a pet with eyes closed; 3. a playful pose; 4. curled up asleep.

pet-rabbit.brief: four animation frames of the same a fluffy white rabbit with grey ears on the floor, about 1 square tall: 1. sitting calmly looking at the viewer; 2. happy, leaning into a pet with eyes closed; 3. a playful pose; 4. curled up asleep.

cursor.brief: five small user interface icons drawn in the fantasy style (brass, warm leather, parchment colours) about 32 pixels each in pixel art: 1. a gloved hand pointing up-left with the index finger extended; 2. the same hand tapping, finger bent slightly down; 3. the same hand closed into a grey fist; 4. a small bright yellow X mark made of two crossed strokes; 5. a small bright red X mark made of two crossed strokes.
